def main(name, output, font):
    """ Easily bootstrap an OS project to fool HR departments and pad your resume. """
    import os
    import sys
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    import argparse
    import tempfile

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Bootstrap an OS project')
    parser.add_argument('name', help='The name of the project')
    parser.add_argument('output', help='The output directory')
    parser.add_argument('--font', help='The font to use', default='DejaVuSansMono.ttf')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    name = args.name
    output = args.output
    font = args.font

    if not os.path.exists(output):
        os.makedirs(output)

    if not os.path.exists(font):
        print("Font file not found: %s" % font)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Create the project
    print("Creating project %s" % name)
    os.chdir(output)
    subprocess.call(['git', 'init'])
    subprocess.call(['git', 'config', 'user.name', 'OS Project'])
    subprocess.call(['git', 'config', 'user.email', 'os@project.com'])
    subprocess.call(['git', 'add', '*'])
    subprocess.call(['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Initial commit'])

    # Create the README
    print("Creating README")
    readme = open('README.md', 'w')
    readme.write('# %s\n' % name)
    readme.write('This is a project created by [OS Project](https://github.com/osproject/osproject).\n')
    readme.write('To get started, clone the repository and run `make`.\n')
    readme.close()

    # Create the Makefile
    print("Creating Makefile")
    makefile = open('Makefile', 'w')
    makefile.write('all:\n')
    makefile.write('\t@echo "Hello, world!"\n')
    makefile.close()

    # Create the LICENSE
